label: High Loneliness, Depression, and Anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively elevated loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms across the measured indicators.
demographic_anchor: Female respondents with graduate-level education or above who report more than 5 hours.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively high loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Represents a subgroup anchored by female respondents with higher educational attainment and more than 5 hours reported

label: Low distress, well-educated male with light daily use
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms. It represents a lower-distress group with generally favorable emotional well-being indicators.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate education or above, 1–3 hours of daily use
behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows low depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9
Shows very low anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7
Appears to fit a lower-distress emotional profile
Associated with light-to-moderate daily use of 1–3 hours

label: Higher loneliness with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report relatively elevated loneliness while showing lower average depressive and anxiety symptoms. The pattern suggests a group marked more by social disconnection than by broader internalizing distress.
demographic_anchor: Typically female, educated to graduate level or above, and associated with the 1-3 hours category.
behavior_markers: Reports comparatively higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows lower average depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows lower average anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Profile is characterized more by perceived social isolation than by strong mood or anxiety burden
tone: Socially disconnected but otherwise comparatively low in depressive and anxiety symptom severity.
